text:
Market today:
The market mood is sour, especially for tech and chips. Geopolitical tensions with Iran are flaring, pushing oil prices up, while tech stocks continue their sell-off. AI plays are taking a hit, and even strong chip earnings aren't enough to satisfy expectations, leading to a broad chip stock rout. This directly impacts your concentrated tech/chip book.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-56.96%) and SPAL (-54.75%) are in dire straits, both leveraged ETFs with massive losses and stops that need immediate adjustment. QQQI (-7.69%) is at its stop. SMH (-16.78%) is also down significantly in the struggling chip sector. Remember, trading on margin amplifies these drops.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on your stops for QQQ and QQQI. Monitor the escalating geopolitical situation and its impact on oil, and watch for any further weakness in the chip sector.

Bottom line:
Prioritize managing your leveraged positions and respecting your stops in this volatile, tech-unfriendly environment.
plays: SOXL / SPAL: Re-evaluate these leveraged ETFs immediately. Their current stops are far from current prices, and their decay combined with heavy losses demands attention.
QQQI: Respect the stop at 52.00. If it breaks, consider trimming or exiting to manage risk.
SLB: Consider a new buy to diversify into energy given rising oil prices. Entry 49.93-49.88, stop 49.81, as per scanner.
